synthetic/PF_02.note: A robot gripper drops a ball onto a stack of cloth sheets; it bounces and settles.

synthetic/B_12.description: Racket strikes a hanging tennis ball
synthetic/B_12.note: Scripted racket swing strikes a hanging ball, compressing it before it springs off.

synthetic/B_13.description: Liquid ball bursts inside a glass sphere
synthetic/B_13.note: A liquid ball collapses inside a glass sphere, bursts up the shell and sloshes down.

synthetic/B_14.note: Fountain jet fills an upper bowl that overflows in sheets and streams into the basin.

synthetic/Z_09.note: Collars twist an elastic bar and a yielding metal bar; one oscillates back, one stays twisted.

synthetic/G_08.description: Nozzle pipes frosting onto a cupcake
synthetic/G_08.note: A scripted nozzle spirals upward, piping frosting into a tapering swirl on a cupcake.

synthetic/B_15.description: Ball topples a tower of cubes
synthetic/B_15.note: A ball rolls down a chute into a tower of small cubes, which collapses into a heap.

synthetic/TM_02.description: Cubes leave craters in goo block
synthetic/TM_02.note: Three rigid cubes drop into a plastic goo block, leaving permanent craters and bulges.

synthetic/G_09.note: A press platen squashes a soft bunny flat, then lifts so it springs back.

synthetic/G_10.description: Five cloth sheets drape onto a ball
synthetic/G_10.note: Five cloth sheets fall onto a ball and each other, rippling and draping into a stack.

synthetic/B_16.description: Jelly beans slump into a heap
synthetic/B_16.note: A tube lifts away, letting jelly beans slump into a wide heap and scatter.

synthetic/ML_01.note: A water jet and a sand jet collide; water wraps the sand and falls into a mixed puddle.

synthetic/B_17.note: Rolling ball smashes a plank castle, which collapses into a spreading debris field.

synthetic/LI_05.note: Cloth sheet falls onto an animated helicopter, wraps it, then slides off onto the floor.

synthetic/Z_10.note: A gripper twists and stretches a soft figurine, which slowly unwinds after release.

synthetic/B_19.description: Water jet fills and overflows a tank
synthetic/B_19.note: A water jet fills a tank, splashes over the wall, and overflows onto the floor.

synthetic/B_20.description: a falling magnet cube attracts a collection of metal balls
synthetic/B_20.note: Falling magnet block pulls a grid of balls up into a cluster that lands around it.

synthetic/B_21.description: drum spins and mixes a bed of marbles
synthetic/B_21.note: A kinematically spun drum tumbles a bed of balls, some spilling onto the floor.

synthetic/ML_02.description: Platen crushes a porous core into grains
synthetic/ML_02.note: A platen crushes a porous core that barrels, tears and sheds grains into heaps.

synthetic/B_23.note: Newton's cradle end balls swing alternately, passing momentum through the hanging row.

synthetic/ML_03.note: A descending plunger extrudes strands from a barrel; they reach the floor and coil into a heap.

synthetic/PF_03.note: Curtain of noodle strands drops into a bowl, buckling and collapsing into a tangled pile.

synthetic/G_11.note: A segmented octopus drops onto blade edges, its arms bending and hanging between blades.

synthetic/CK_04.note: Dropped Oreo lands on edge and snaps into two halves, exposing sticky cream and crumbs.

synthetic/G_12.description: Paper press folds two sheets and one stays creased
synthetic/G_12.note: A hinged leaf folds two sheets shut; one stays creased, the other springs back open.

synthetic/G_13.note: Four viscous pastes drain from funnels, coiling and spreading into piles on the bench.

synthetic/B_24.note: A cue strikes the cue ball, which breaks the rack; balls scatter and some fall off the table.

synthetic/PF_04.description: Ball collapses a house of cards
synthetic/PF_04.note: Rolling ball strikes a house of cards, collapsing its left flank as cards slide.

synthetic/PF_05.note: Three soft armadillos drop onto taut cables, flexing and tumbling as the cables sag.

synthetic/PF_06.note: Puller tightens a strap knot through a wall ring while the free strap twists into ripples.

synthetic/PF_07.description: Soft figures slide at different frictions
synthetic/PF_07.note: Four soft figures land on a slope; lower-friction ones slide down, higher-friction ones stick.

synthetic/PF_08.description: Ball bounces off cloth draped on a cone
synthetic/PF_08.note: Cloths drape over a cone tip; a robot then drops a ball that bounces off the tent.

synthetic/PF_09.description: Knotted tube is pinched through rollers
synthetic/PF_09.note: A soft knotted tube is pulled down between rollers, pinched thin, then drops and recovers its shape.

synthetic/HM_06.description: Spindles wind soft chain links into a braid
synthetic/HM_06.note: Spindles counter-rotate a chain's end rings, winding soft links into braids around rigid rings.

synthetic/HM_07.description: Foam pillars twisted into a braid until they fracture
synthetic/HM_07.note: A rotating disc twists foam pillars with embedded balls into a braid until they tear.

synthetic/CK_05.description: Pumpkin falls on top of another pumpkin, fracturing both
synthetic/CK_05.note: Pumpkin drops onto another; both shells squash and tear open on impact.

synthetic/G_14.description: Ribbon extrudes into pleats on a belt
synthetic/G_14.note: A ribbon extrudes onto a moving belt and buckles into regular pleats carried away.

synthetic/B_25.description: Rope winds around a a metal bar
synthetic/B_25.note: A rope with a brass ball swings down and winds around a steel peg.

synthetic/CK_06.note: Two sand armadillos collide mid-air, fuse, fall, and slump into a flat patch.

synthetic/TM_03.note: Spinning blade stirs sand in a bowl into ridges while a pipe pours more sand.

synthetic/CK_07.description: Sand armadillo hits an elastic one
synthetic/CK_07.note: A sand armadillo hits an elastic armadillo mid-air and collapses into a grain pile.

synthetic/B_26.note: Falling chrome sphere tips a seesaw plank, launching a smiley ball out of its cup.

synthetic/G_15.description: Shaving cream coils into a mound
synthetic/G_15.note: A shaving-cream thread coils from a nozzle and piles into a tangled mound.

synthetic/Z_11.note: Clamps stretch a rubber disc into an oval, release it, and it creeps back round.

synthetic/B_27.description: Sink fills through a faucet and drains
synthetic/B_27.note: Tap water fills a sink basin into a sloshing pool, then drains after the tap closes.

synthetic/B_28.description: Thick liquid floods a spillway basin
synthetic/B_28.note: Thick liquid pours from a slit, surges around obstacles and floods the basin.

synthetic/ML_04.description: Snowball rolls down an incline, hitting a snowman
synthetic/ML_04.note: A snow lump tumbles down a snowy ramp, scraping a furrow, and stops against a snowman.

synthetic/B_29.description: Soft shapes fall through a pinned chute
synthetic/B_29.note: Twenty-five soft rubber shapes fall through a pinned chute, bouncing off plates into heaps.

synthetic/B_30.note: A soft rubber tyre hops down each stair step, flexing slightly, then rolls away.

synthetic/S_01.note: Rigid cereal rings slide off a chute into water, splash and spread into a floating layer.

synthetic/S_02.note: A water column collapses into a surge that sweeps floating ducks against the wall and back.

synthetic/S_03.description: Colliding jets form a water bell
synthetic/S_03.note: Two colliding water jets form a disc that closes into a steady bell.

synthetic/B_31.description: Tipped jug pours marbles into a bucket
synthetic/B_31.note: A kinematically tipped glass jug pours marbles into a bucket, where they heap.

synthetic/CK_08.description: Twisted bar tears in the middle
synthetic/CK_08.note: Counter-rotating clamps twist an elastic bar until it tears, the middle piece falling.

synthetic/G_16.description: Robot arms flatten dough with a plate
synthetic/G_16.note: Two robot arms push a plate down, flattening a dough ball into a disc.

synthetic/CK_09.note: Elastic green and plastic orange dragons collide; orange ones tear into a lump and shards.

synthetic/LI_07.note: A soft armadillo falls onto counter-rotating rollers and gets squeezed down through the gap.

synthetic/LI_08.note: Ten-link chain drops from a bunched start under the ceiling and hangs still.

synthetic/LI_09.description: Four rods twist into a helical rope
synthetic/LI_09.note: Rotating end mounts twist four pinned rods into a tight helical rope.

synthetic/B_32.note: Gold ball rolls down five zigzag wall plates and drops into a bin.

synthetic/Z_12.note: A falling watermelon squashes and bursts, rind shattering and flesh spraying across the ground.

synthetic/B_33.description: Wrecking ball scatters a cube stack
synthetic/B_33.note: A chain-hung wrecking ball swings through a cube stack, scattering the blocks.
